analysis.file_name: GS Blekos - ## Cross-Asset Outlook FOMC Minutes Carbonomics Oil Services ASML Airtel Europe Hardware Tencent ## 19 Nov 2026.pdf
analysis.title: Cross-Asset Outlook / FOMC Minutes / Carbonomics / Oil Services / ASML / Airtel / Europe Hardware / Tencent
key_insights: GS GOAL 2027 outlook: modestly pro-risk, favouring more balance across and within assets as nominal and earnings growth approach a peak after the 2026 AI capex boom and energy-driven inflation boost.
Near-term risks GS flags as elevated: AI concerns, renewed energy shocks, more aggressive Fed tightening and persistent fiscal concerns.

GS says the balance between slowing growth and rates relief should drive risk appetite in 2027. A peak in nominal growth need not end the bull market if inflation falls and real growth stays resilient.
GS expects easing energy prices and normalising inflation to limit further policy tightening and let bond yields decline gradually.
October FOMC minutes: 'most' participants supported holding the fed funds rate at 3.75-4.00%, and 'many' cited the benefits of accumulating additional information.

'Some' participants, including dissenters Governor Cook and President Hammack, favored a 25bp hike and called the stance 'not sufficiently restrictive'. 'A few' of the participants who backed a hold called it a close call.

'Almost all' FOMC participants judged that further action to raise the target range 'would likely be appropriate' under their baseline outlooks. 'A couple' flagged that a hike larger than 25bp could warrant consideration at the next meeting if incoming inflation data were unfavorable.
Carbonomics: GS says the current emission trajectory is more likely to bring 2.5-2.9°C of warming than the 1.5-2°C target, and coal consumption is still rising.

Carbonomics: GS reviews geo-engineering cooling technologies that raise Earth's albedo. It frames them as a future climate-management tool and not a substitute for de-carbonization, with governance, environmental risk and execution still open.

European oil services: GS's Top Projects database shows c.280 mtpa of LNG capacity reaching FID across 2025-30, up c.52 mtpa (23%) from c.228 mtpa in TP2026. It cites disruption through the Strait of Hormuz as a partial catalyst.
European oil services: GTT is GS's preferred exposure to the LNG FID wave, and Technip is cut to Neutral.

ASML: after a Wilton site visit GS reiterates Buy (on Conviction List). Takeaways are High NA momentum, a deep competitive moat, output optimisation avenues, installed base and upgrade momentum, and Match Act concerns that GS views as overdone.
Airtel Mobile Commerce (Airtel Money): GS initiates at Neutral and expects a revenue ex-FX CAGR of c.26% over FY26-31E across 13 markets in East and Francophone Africa.

Europe hardware read-across from Nvidia 3QFY27: GS sees ASML best positioned for its leading-edge Logic and Memory exposure, moat and lead times. ASMI, BESI and TPRO should benefit from process complexity and from advanced packaging and testing needs.
Tencent 3Q26 first take (Buy): revenue grew +8% and operating profit fell -6% yoy, 2ppts and 6ppts below GSe on softer international games and elevated AI spending.
Tencent: record capex and compute prepayments are driving FCF outflow, and GS cut 4Q26E/FY27E/FY28E adj. net profit by 5%/11%/11%.

market_movers.rationale: Reiterated Buy on the Conviction List after the Wilton site visit, citing High NA momentum, a deep moat and installed base upgrades. GS sees Match Act concerns as overdone.
Technip Energies cut to Neutral as GS prefers GTT for exposure to the growing LNG FID wave.
GTT is GS's preferred exposure to the LNG investment cycle, with c.280 mtpa of capacity expected to reach FID across 2025-30.
Initiated Airtel Mobile Commerce at Neutral, expecting a revenue ex-FX CAGR of c.26% over FY26-31E.
Tencent kept at Buy after 3Q26 revenue and operating profit missed GSe on softer international games and elevated AI spending. GS cut FY27E and FY28E adj. net profit by 11%.

sector_views.rationale: The LNG FID cycle is accelerating, with c.280 mtpa of capacity reaching FID across 2025-30, up 23% from the prior Top Projects estimate. GS prefers GTT and cuts Technip to Neutral.
GS sees ASML best positioned and ASMI, BESI and TPRO benefiting from process complexity and advanced packaging and testing needs, following Nvidia's 3QFY27 results.

earnings_insights: Tencent 3Q26 (first take, reported): revenue +8% yoy and operating profit -6% yoy, 2ppts and 6ppts below GSe (GS estimate, not consensus), on softer international games and elevated AI spending.
Tencent: GS cut 4Q26E/FY27E/FY28E adj. net profit by 5%/11%/11%, citing record capex and compute prepayments, slower core top-line and profit growth, and rising investment in new AI products.
Nvidia 3QFY27 results were reported before this note. GS reads them across to European AI-indexed names and does not state Nvidia figures in this note.
Airtel Money: GS forecasts (estimate) a revenue ex-FX CAGR of c.26% over FY26-31E.

macro_indicators.reading: 25bp, with 'a couple' of participants open to more
macro_indicators.interpretation: A hike larger than 25bp could be considered if incoming inflation data are unfavorable, per the minutes.
